exit_code_legend.note: START_HERE.md frozen legend is about rc SEMANTICS per batch; this batch follows it. Every command below also states its OWN expected rc. Historical rc across other batches is NOT rewritten.
exit_code_legend.0: pass - command ended normally AND the business verdict is pass
exit_code_legend.1: harness failure - the runner/test itself errored (import, fixture, missing expectation file, unbound path)
exit_code_legend.2: no verdict / expected refusal - a negative case that was correctly refused
exit_code_legend.3: did not meet expectation - positive case not passing, or negative case NOT refused
